title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Duo #11 (부채꼴 4구역·물결 / 가로 띠 4구역·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult French woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, demure and soft, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 41% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 6 o'clock, 8 o'clock, 1 o'clock and 3 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, with geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 1 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 1 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Nigerian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, sultry, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, matte finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 4 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 37% of the way down her figure from the top, about 55% of the way down her figure from the top and about 70% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with overglaze florals filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform square-toe heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 8K.
